description: The Phase 4 screen move (issue #2373). Moves one tool/architecture/context_map.json group (legacy entries with moveTo and group) into apps/<app>/lib, lib/pages or a context's actions/ and data/ folders: each library with its handwritten and generated parts, directives rewritten across packages, barrel imports in moving files split into direct imports, barrel exports of files leaving lib/ deleted, tests and golden baselines following their imports, path mentions rewritten, moved files from legacy paths carried in tool/architecture/carried_screens.json (stale carries dropped by catch_arch_stale_carry) and generated outputs regenerated by their generators. Plans with dart_symbol_imports.dart, an analyzer-resolved import graph that sees through barrels and conditional imports and walks the router by its isHostApp flag. --classify labels every legacy file host, consumer, shared or unreached; --plan reports moves and blocking errors (closure, cross-app, layer, context order, dependencies, test support, fixture reads, stale folders); --apply writes one commit and a tool/architecture/screen_move_log.json entry; --verify accepts only what a move may change; --imports-only replays logged moves onto other branches; --check keeps lib/ and the shared packages free of app imports and every moveTo valid.
